stem: How does the source define amblyopia?

options.text: A reduction in visual acuity due to interrupted development during the sensitive period.
The physical misalignment of the two eyes.
A condition where both eyes require different lens prescriptions.
The presence of an intraocular tumor blocking the macula.

explanation: Amblyopia is specifically linked to the interruption of normal visual development in the early years of life.
rationale: Focus on the functional visual loss that occurs because the brain doesn't learn to see properly during childhood.

optionExplanations.A: Amblyopia is specifically linked to the interruption of normal visual development in the early years of life.
optionExplanations.B: This is the definition of strabismus, which can cause amblyopia, but is not amblyopia itself.
optionExplanations.C: This describes anisometropia, which is a cause of amblyopia rather than the definition of the condition.
optionExplanations.D: While a tumor can cause form deprivation leading to amblyopia, it is an underlying pathology rather than the definition of amblyopia.
